skills.name: Starfrost, Showtime!
skills.desc: Deals #1[i]% Quantum Elation DMG to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: This Emanator Was Certified by Aha™
skills.desc: Enables one designated ally character (excluding this unit) to gain the "Emanator of Elation" state, then immediately launches Follow-up ATK, dealing #2[i]% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies. The "Emanator of Elation" state lasts for the entire battle until it switches to the next target. The target with the "Emanator of Elation" state has their Elation stat increased by #1[i]% and, at the start of their turn, enables Aeon ★ Aha to gain #6[i] point(s) of "Wishpower."

skills.name: Aha! Let There Be Laughter
skills.desc: Aha's action advances by #5[i]%. Aeon ★ Aha gains the "Faces of Elation" state, lasting for #6[i] turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Aeon ★ Aha's every turn. Deals #2[i]% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies. Then, deals #3[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing #4[i]% Quantum Elation DMG to one random enemy.

skills.name: Work Wonders with THEM
skills.desc: Can activate Ultimate after "Wishpower" reaches #8[i]. After reaching its upper limit, Wishpower can still overflow up to #11[i]. After using Basic ATK, Skill, or Elation Skill, Aeon ★ Aha gains #7[i] "Wishpower." After allies' Punchline reaches #2[i] for the first time, Aeon ★ Aha will immediately gain #3[i] "Wishpower" and then increase all allies' CRIT DMG by #9[i]%, lasting for #10[i] turn(s). This can trigger again after Aha's turn ends.

skills.name: ABRACADABRA!
skills.desc: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension around this unit, lasting for #2[i] second(s). Enemies within this Special Dimension get inflicted with "Optical Illusion." Once inflicted with "Optical Illusion," they cannot detect ally targets. After entering combat, Aha immediately gains 1 extra turn where a fixed amount of #1[i] Punchline is taken into account. This turn does not consume Punchline. Only 1 dimension effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

skills.name: Yes Aha At Full Moon
skills.desc: Always gets used at the end of Aha Instant regardless of Participant ID. Deals #1[i]% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies, and deals True DMG based on #2[i]% of total non-True DMG dealt by ally targets during this Aha Instant, distributed evenly among all enemies.

passives.name: A Prank on Aeons
passives.desc: Skill's Follow-Up ATK additionally deals 20% Elation DMG of the same Type as the target who holds the "Emanator of Elation" state, and recovers 1 Skill Point(s). This additionally dealt Elation DMG is not considered as an instance of attack.

passives.name: A Carnival in Whimsy
passives.desc: When receiving healing or a Shield provided by a teammate, gains 1 "Wishpower." This can be triggered up to 1 time(s). The trigger count resets after the Ultimate is used.

passives.name: A Box of Everything
passives.desc: When Aeon ★ Aha's SPD reaches 125/150 or higher, the Elation stat increases by 120%/150%, respectively. When combat starts, own action advances by 30%.
